info.name: EchoGPT API
info.description:
EchoGPT backend API.

1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3000).
2. Run **Auth → Create an account** or **Log in** — the tokens are saved to collection variables automatically and every protected request uses them.
3. For admin requests, log in as the seeded admin (`ADMIN_EMAIL` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD`).
4. Ids (`providerId`, `conversationId`, `searchId`, `userId`) are captured automatically by the requests that create or list them; edit the variables to target something else.

Full reference: Swagger UI at {{baseUrl}}/docs.
